ledger_conventions.pl_rounding: Each play settles to a 2-decimal P/L (American-odds payout rounded at settlement). Running units = sum of these rounded per-play values, so the ledger column sums EXACTLY to the total (sportsbook-settlement convention, chosen for auditability). Note: summing unrounded payouts can differ by ~0.01u (e.g. baseline 7/23 is +0.48u rounded, +0.49u unrounded).
ledger_conventions.brier_ab: raw-vs-shrunk Brier/logloss compared only on plays where BOTH probabilities exist (engine skips produce no shrunk_p). 7/23 n_both=4 (Dobnak excluded).
ledger_conventions.objective: profitability = EV vs price break-even, NOT win% > 50%.

rule.1_both_sides: For every game on the slate, compute V13 P(win) for BOTH sides. No pre-filtering by lean.
rule.2_gate: Qualify a side iff EV > 0 AND edge (= p - implied) >= 0.04. Same thresholds engine/kprops.select_play already uses; not tuned for this ledger.
rule.3_trust: Exclude any game flagged capped (a starter is TBD or has <5 GS). Log the exclusion explicitly, never silently.
rule.4_no_discretion: Register EVERY side that qualifies. No conviction ranking, no trimming, no vetoes.
rule.5_price: Freeze the opening-snapshot price as the graded price. Record the closing price separately for CLV (feeds E3).

experiment_queue.title: Opponent-K% adjustment for K-props
experiment_queue.method: log5/odds-ratio combine of pitcher as-of shrunk K-rate p with as-of opponent team K-rate-taken o [o = (SigmaSO + L*N0)/(Sigma(AB+BB) + N0), N0=200, denominator AB+BB per principal 7/24] vs league L: adj=(p*o/L)/((p*o/L)+((1-p)(1-o)/(1-L))); E[TBF] unchanged; Poisson tails unchanged. Strict as-of (date<D), DH=start-of-day both games.

experiment_queue.adopt_rule: GENERAL adopt requires ALL: overall MAE down >=0.03K; Brier not worse + calib slope [0.9,1.1]; displaced-hit >= baseline (or deferred if <150 lined starts); complement slice also improves (not interaction-only); flipped-decision set net non-negative ROI.
